Name: Traveler's map
Author: Dipendor
Description:
﻿﻿[b][size=6]🌿Traveler's Map🌿[/size][/b]

This mod is made for those who are tired of running from location to location through dozens of black loading screens.﻿
[color=#808080]This is not a replacement for the original map, it is a separate functionality![/color]

Mod adds an interactive world map that allows you to quickly teleport to various locations across Stardew Valley and supported modded areas.
﻿
Press [b]B[/b] to open the new world map

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zBFnN4Bp/ginger-island.png[/img]
[color=#808080]You can change the mod's settings with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].[/color]
[color=#808080](
1. Enable/Disable free ride (disabled by default)[/color]
[color=#808080]2. Сhange the menu-opening button (B by default)[/color]
[color=#808080]3. Display player's farms  (enabled by default)[/color]
[color=#808080])[/color]

Each teleport costs [color=gold][b]Gold[/b][/color], making travel convenient but balanced.
﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Lsyf5jSQ/750-hover.png[/img]
